items.exampleEn: Jumping into the river to help the boy was a brave act.
items.exampleZh: 跳進河裡救那個男孩是很勇敢的舉動。

items.exampleEn: Nobody claimed the umbrella, so we kept it.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人來認領那把傘，所以我們就留著了。
我爺爺創立了這家餐廳。

items.exampleEn: Try to avoid the busy roads in the morning.
items.exampleZh: 早上盡量避開車多的路。
她終於說出了她的祕密。

items.exampleEn: I want to apply for this job.
I managed to finish the work on time.
items.exampleZh: 我設法準時完成了工作。

items.exampleEn: The band will perform in the park tonight.
items.exampleZh: 這個樂團今晚會在公園表演。

items.sentenceEn: She applied to three schools last year.
items.sentenceZh: 她去年申請了三所學校。

items.audioEn: To avoid traffic, I leave home at six every morning.
items.audioZh: 為了避開車潮，我每天早上六點出門。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼六點就出門？

items.sentenceEn: She managed to find a seat.
items.sentenceZh: 她設法找到了一個位子。

items.sentenceEn: The children performed a short play for their parents.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們為爸媽演出了一齣短劇。

items.stemEn: You can ____ your bags over there.
items.stemZh: 你可以在那邊領取你的行李。

items.stemEn: It's dangerous. Please ____ driving in heavy rain.
items.stemZh: 很危險，下大雨時請避免開車。

items.passageEn: Lucy has always loved music. Last year, she managed to establish a small music school in her town. She also performs at a cafe every Friday night. Recently, she applied to the city for money to buy new pianos. She revealed a secret: she was very shy as a child. "I tried to avoid singing in front of people," she said. "Starting this school was a brave act for me."
items.passageZh: Lucy 一直都熱愛音樂。去年，她設法在鎮上創立了一所小型音樂學校。她每週五晚上也會在一家咖啡店表演。最近，她向市政府申請經費來買新鋼琴。她透露了一個祕密：她小時候非常害羞。她說：「我以前總是避免在別人面前唱歌。創辦這所學校對我來說是很勇敢的舉動。」

options: 出了一張自己的鋼琴獨奏唱片
搬到大城市的音樂學校教書
創立了一所小型音樂學校

items.promptZh: 這家公司成立於 2010 年。
rubricZh: 「成立於」可寫例如 was established in、was started in；寫 The company started in 2010 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 avoid 造一個句子，說說你平常會避免做的一件事。
referenceEn: I avoid drinking coffee at night.
I try to avoid the crowded trains.
rubricZh: avoid 後面接名詞或動名詞（例如 avoid the crowded trains、avoid drinking coffee），不接 to＋動詞
說平常的習慣用現在式（例如 avoid、try to avoid）
